items.source: Create a new MergedAnnotations instance containing all annotations and meta-annotations from the specified element and, depending on the MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy, related inherited elements.
items.translation: 创建一个包含指定元素的所有注解和元注解的新的MergedAnnotations实例，并且根据MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy，包含相关的继承元素。

items.source: Search strategies supported by MergedAnnotations.search(SearchStrategy) as well as MergedAnnotations.from(AnnotatedElement, SearchStrategy) and variants of that method.
items.translation: `MergedAnnotations.search(SearchStrategy)`、`MergedAnnotations.from(AnnotatedElement, SearchStrategy)` 以及该方法的变体所支持的搜索策略。

items.source: Uses of MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy in org.springframework.core.annotation
Find merged annotations using the supplied MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy and a fluent API for configuring and performing the search.
items.translation: 使用提供的MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy和用于配置及执行搜索的流式 API 来查找合并的注解。

items.source:
Core support package for annotations, meta-annotations, and merged
annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 用于注解、元注解以及带有属性覆盖的合并注解的核心支持包。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
